IC1: presence of typical HF symptoms and signs
IC3: elevated levels of NT-proBNP (at least >125 pg/ml)
IC4: echocardiographic structural (a left atrial volume index > [OR] 34 mL/m2 or a left ventricular mass index =1 [OR]15 g/m2 for males and =95 g/m2 for females) or functional alterations (E/e'=13 and a mean e' septal and lateral wall < 9 cm/s).
